description: Conversion of dwelling into two flats (2 X 3 bed); landscaping; bin and cycle stores
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

<p><u>Permeable Paving</u></p><p class="MsoNormal"><span lang="EN-US">Notwithstanding the approved details, </span>the development hereby approved shall be
occupied until <span lang="EN-US">full details, including cross-sections, of the permeable paving and details
relating to the long term maintenance and management of the on-site drainage
shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The details thereby approved shall be retained thereafter.&nbsp;<o:p></o:p></span></p>
The refuse bins shall be stored at all times, other than on collection days, in the designated refuse storage area, as shown on the approved drawing.

<p class="MsoNormal"><u>Cycle Parking&nbsp;</u></p><p class="MsoNormal">The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until
details relating to the provision of a minimum of 4 no. secure and sheltered
cycle storage spaces in two separate cycle storage containers has been
submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The
development shall be completed in accordance with the approved details prior to
the occupation of the development and shall thereafter be retained.<o:p></o:p></p>

<p><u>Use</u></p><p class="MsoNormal">The development hereby permitted shall be used for Class C3
dwellinghouse(s) only and notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and
Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any
Order revoking or re-enacting that Order with or without modification), no
development within Schedule 2, Part 3, Class L shall take place.<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNormal"><u style="">Fire Safety</u></p><p class="MsoNormal">The development hereby approved shall not be occupied
until&nbsp;a Fire Safety Statement&nbsp;has been submitted to and approved in
writing by the Local Planning Authority, this statement shall include details
of how the development will function in terms of the following:<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal">1) identify suitably positioned unobstructed outside space:
a) for fire appliances to be positioned on b) appropriate for use as an
evacuation assembly point<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal">2) is designed to incorporate appropriate features which
reduce the risk to life and the risk of serious injury in the event of a fire;
including appropriate fire alarm systems and passive and active fire safety
measures<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal">3) is constructed in an appropriate way to minimise the risk
of fire spread<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal">4) provide suitable and convenient means of escape, and
associated evacuation strategy for all building users<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal">5) develop a robust management strategy for evacuation which
is to be periodically updated and published (details of how often this
management strategy is to be reviewed and published to be included), and which
all building users can have confidence in<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal">6) provide suitable access and equipment for firefighting
which is appropriate for the size and use of the development.<o:p></o:p></p><p>













</p><p class="MsoNormal">The development shall be operated in accordance with the
approved details in perpetuity.<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNormal"><u style="">Landscaping Compliance <b><o:p></o:p></b></u></p><p>

</p><p class="MsoNormal">All planting, seeding or turfing comprised in the approved
details of landscaping shall be carried out in the first planting and seeding
seasons following the occupation of the building(s), or the completion of the
development, whichever is the sooner.&nbsp; Any existing or new trees or shrubs
which, within a period of 5 years from the completion of the development, die,
are removed, or become seriously damaged or diseased, shall be replaced in the
next planting season, with others of a similar size and species, unless the
local authority agrees any variation in writing.<o:p></o:p></p>
